name: ps-live-1
label: simulated using Lucid Trading's published rules as read on 2026-11-09; not affiliated with or endorsed by Lucid

feed.label: Alpaca's free real-time IEX feed (IEX is a small share of the market's volume, not the consolidated tape); stand-in, regular hours only, not futures

gapRule: from the first unobserved minute of a session: nothing decided or traded for the rest of that session; a working order cancelled; an open position closed at the close of the last live bar before the gap, less 1 tick
horizons: matrix-1.json horizons (60 evaluation sessions, 120 funded sessions)
attempts: one at a time; evaluation, then on a pass the funded stage to the first payout, a breach or its horizon; the next evaluation starts at the next session after the attempt ends
